name: Forstan Millenias
original_name: フォルスタン・ミレニアス
source: Royal Prince. Usually, he is a stoic man who doesn't show many expressions. However, when his fiancée rejects him and wants to cancel the engagement, he becomes emotional and decides to make her his forever no matter what.
